---
title: "Summary"
---

The Summary task mainly brings together data from other taks in the pipeline into a single file. Some of the contents of this file are copied into a database, which is used to populate the user interface and form the basis of reports downloaded by users.

Data is typically unmodified by the summary process, but for species naming the summary code draws together information from [Competitive Mapping](competitive_mapping.qmd) and [Lineage Calling](lineage_calling.qmd) (mykrobe) to assign a species name and, as appropriate, a lineage or subspecies. The code also accomodates situations where mixed M. tuberculosis complex lineages are identified.

The details of this are documented in the Summary Pipeline readme ([README.md](https://github.com/softwaremmm/summary_pipeline/blob/main/README.md)) and a seperate document covering species calling ([speciation.md](https://github.com/softwaremmm/summary_pipeline/blob/main/speciation.md)). It is helpful to store this documentation under the same version control system as the code it pertains to, to avoid divergence.

# Thresholds
If TB was found at high enough levels to process it will always be displayed as the top hit, ahead of NTMs. Otherwise is ordered based on mean-depth, which is how competitive mapping orders them.
